member.name: ChapterPhrase
member.para: The one corpus mark a pause-only guard would have cost. "I Shall Wear Midnight" chapter 9, whose announcement follows the previous chapter's last words after 0.64 s against a threshold of 0.85 s, its mark otherwise perfect at -105.6 dBFS. It is the one mark of the sixteen-book corpus with under 0.85 s in front of it; the next-lowest has 0.99 s. It is affordable because that chapter is transcribed as a segment of its own, so the segment-start route satisfies its ^.

The three transcripts that read a word the narrator never said. Three of the corpus's 12,916 probe transcripts read "Der erste Kapitel 5" (BARDIOC, Die Maahks and Gruelfin, 2026-08-14). "Der erste" is not even grammatical, and the neighbouring probes of the same announcement transcribe it plainly as "Kapitel 5." - so what it exposes is Whisper filling a short window's opening with plausible words.
